rv.q: This odd little show has charm aplenty, though for some it may also prove something of a well-intentioned dog’s dinner.
Giving human voices to pets was something of a double-edged sword in this case.
Even his skills can’t salvage this show.
Dog Mom has bags of heart, but it could dig deeper.
By taking itself a touch too seriously, “Dog Mom” weakens the messages that are better served with humour.
Well meaning canine comedy goes astray.

cn.t: Critics find this comedy about a childless woman and her canine companions mostly misguided, with human actors playing dogs drawing particular skepticism, though the dog characters themselves earn some praise.
